summary: A Python command-line tool on Typer, packaged as a wheel, with layered settings, text or JSON output and fixed exit codes.
description: Write a Python command-line tool with Typer commands and pydantic-settings, layered from defaults, a TOML file, environment variables and flags. Commands print text or one JSON document, errors carry a suggestion and map to fixed exit codes, and logs go to stderr. uv and make run lint, strict typing and pytest, build the wheel and run it from a clean install. Add your tool's commands; publishing to PyPI is a step you set up yourself.
seoDescription: A Python CLI recipe on Typer with pydantic-settings config, text or JSON output, exit codes and a wheel tested from a clean install.

projectExamples.title: Log file summarizer
projectExamples.description: Add a command that reads local log files and prints counts by level, as a table for people or JSON for scripts. Reuse the output and exit-code contract.

projectExamples.title: Team release helper
projectExamples.description: Add commands that check a repository's changelog and version before a release, with defaults in the shared config file and overrides from environment variables.

plain.whatItIs: A starter for a terminal program written in Python that people install with one command and run by name.
goodAt: Commands that read settings from a file, environment variables and flags
